Definition: or μή ποτε from G3361 and G4218; not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps):--if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not.
BiblicalUsage: Mepote means lest at any time, if peradventure, and it guards both a hope and a warning. 2 Timothy 2:25 hopes that God peradventure will give repentance to those who oppose themselves, and Acts 5:39 warns the council, lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word holds the door open both ways: repentance may yet come, and fighting God is still possible.
